ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-contrast; approximately 90-95% low-intensity black field versus 5-10% high-intensity white/light-grey regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black pigmentation across both lobes. High-intensity vertical white band localized immediately right of the median notch. High-intensity clusters concentrated at the extreme lateral tips. Sparse circular high-intensity spots scattered across the interior of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees; depth extends approximately 12% into the vertical fluke plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of variations is highest on the distal half of the right lobe, featuring peaks of 10-20 pixels relative to the mean edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve trajectory; initial convexity near the median notch transitioning to a linear-to-concave sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast circular clusters at the extreme distal tips (consistent with barnacle attachment sites). Isolated circular high-contrast spots present on the left lobe interior.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct vertical, unaligned linear pixel disruptions on the left lobe surface; one horizontal disruption on the right lobe near the median notch area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent V-shaped secondary excision on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the median notch; distinct white linear scarification on the left lobe ventral surface.
